title: Aquarius Emoji ♒ Meaning: Water Bearer, Air Sign
description: The ♒ Aquarius emoji shows two wavy lines for the Water Bearer sign, January 20 to February 18. Learn its uses and why Aquarius is not a water sign.
summary: The ♒ Aquarius emoji represents Aquarius, the Water Bearer, the zodiac sign for people born from about January 20 to February 18. It marks a sign in bios and posts and nods to the Aquarius image: independent, unconventional, idealistic, and a little detached.
meaning: Two parallel zigzag lines make up the Aquarius glyph. They depict the water poured out by the Water Bearer, a figure tipping a jar in the constellation. The emoji labels the eleventh zodiac sign and is used the way all the sign emoji are: next to birthdays, in profiles, and on horoscope posts for late January and February.

Here is the fact that trips people up: Aquarius is an air sign. Despite the name, the waves, and the jar, astrology groups it with Gemini and Libra, and some astrologers prefer to read the glyph as ripples of energy or electricity. Its quality is fixed, and its rulers are Saturn in the traditional system and Uranus in the modern one, a planet astrologers link with invention and rebellion.

The resulting persona is the eccentric. Aquarians in memes are aliens among humans: full of big ideas, devoted to causes, fond of their friends in theory but slow to reply to texts. People use ♒ to claim that difference proudly ("not weird, just ♒") or to explain emotional distance. The phrase "Age of Aquarius," popularized by the 1960s musical Hair, keeps the sign linked with utopian, hippie-era ideals.

contexts.label: In bios and birthday posts
contexts.body: ♒ appears with late January and February dates and in chart listings. Because the season includes Valentine's Day at its tail end, some birthday posts joke about the sign's unromantic reputation. Accounts devoted to science fiction, activism, or niche hobbies sometimes adopt it as a badge of nonconformity.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Friends use it for the person who vanishes for a week and returns with a new obsession, or who argues the contrarian side for fun. It can excuse a delayed reply. As a compliment, it credits someone with original thinking or with caring about the bigger picture.

contexts.label: On TikTok and Instagram
contexts.body: Aquarius-season videos lean into alien, futuristic, and "different from the other signs" humor, with blue and silver aesthetics. The emoji is often paired with 👽, ⚡, or 🌊, the last one chosen for looks even though the sign's element is air.

examples.text: Saw your message four days ago, replying now with a full essay ♒
examples.meaning: An Aquarius joking about being distant and then intense.

examples.text: February 1 ♒ still the weird one in the family
examples.meaning: A birthday post embracing the sign's oddball image.

examples.text: Everyone liked the movie so now I don't ♒
examples.meaning: The sender admits to being contrarian on principle.

examples.text: Aquarius season ♒⚡ time for strange ideas
examples.meaning: A caption celebrating innovation and unconventional thinking.

examples.text: Reminder that ♒ is an AIR sign, I don't make the rules
examples.meaning: A correction of the common belief that Aquarius is a water sign.

combos.meaning: Sudden ideas and electric energy, linked with Uranus.
The Water Bearer and the jar being poured.

confusedWith.difference: 🌊 is a large ocean wave used for the sea, surfing, and being overwhelmed. The Aquarius glyph only suggests water symbolically. Beach and weather posts call for 🌊; birthdays and horoscopes call for ♒.
〰️ is a single wavy line from Japanese punctuation, used to lengthen a sound or as decoration. ♒ has two stacked zigzags on a purple tile and refers strictly to the zodiac sign.

avoid: Do not use ♒ as a symbol for water, swimming, or the ocean; readers will take it as the star sign.
Avoid calling someone cold or robotic with it in a serious talk about feelings, where the joke dismisses their concern.
design: Two white zigzag lines, one above the other, on a purple square. The points are sharp on some platforms and softer on others, but the paired-wave design is universal. Like every zodiac emoji it uses the shared purple tile, which is the fastest way to distinguish it from wave and line symbols.

faqs.a: No. Aquarius is an air sign, together with Gemini and Libra. The water signs are Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces. The confusion comes from the name, which is Latin for water carrier, and from the wavy glyph.
About January 20 to February 18. The sign follows Capricorn and is followed by Pisces. In some years the boundary dates fall a day earlier or later.

faqs.q: What does ♒ mean from a guy or girl?
faqs.a: They are naming their sign or pointing to Aquarius-style behavior: independence, quirkiness, needing space. It is not a romantic signal. If they send it after going quiet, it may be a half-apology.

faqs.q: What is the Age of Aquarius?
faqs.a: An astrological idea that humanity moves through long eras named for zodiac signs, with an Aquarian age said to favor freedom and progress. Astrologers disagree on when it starts. The phrase became famous through a song in the musical Hair.
